title: Principal Field Security Engineer
Public Cloud Network – Security Engineer - VP
description_html: Overview of the Role:      Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments, and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management.       As a bank with a brain and a soul, Citi creates economic value that is systemically responsible and in our clients’ best interests. As a financial institution that touches every region of the world and every sector that shapes your daily life, our Enterprise Operations & Technology teams are charged with a mission that rivals any large tech company. Our technology solutions are the foundations of everything we do from keeping the bank safe, managing global resources, and providing the technical tools our workers need to be successful to designing our digital architecture and ensuring our platforms provide a first-class customer experience. We reimagine client and partner experiences to deliver excellence through secure, reliable, and efficient services.       Our commitment to diversity includes a workforce that represents the clients we serve from all walks of life, backgrounds, and origins. We foster an environment where the best people want to work. We value and demand respect for others, promote individuals based on merit, and ensure opportunities for personal development are widely available to all. Ideal candidates are innovators with well-rounded backgrounds who bring their authentic selves to work and complement our culture of delivering results with pride. If you are a problem solver who seeks passion in your work, come join us. We’ll enable growth and progress together.       About the Opportunity:     Are you a talented Public Cloud Network – Security Engineer looking for their next challenge?  Do you have a passion for building cutting-edge enterprise products and a hands-on approach to engineering? Join Citi's Cloud Technology Services (CTS) team and be part of our commitment to transform Citi technology, leveraging game-changing Cloud capabilities to drive agility, efficiency, and innovation.   We are providing our businesses with a competitive edge by leveraging public cloud scale and enabling new infrastructure economics As an Network Security Engineer within the Network Infrastructure Team, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and executing our public cloud strategy.   You will be part of a Public Cloud team that continues to deliver big by designing and managing the platform that enables the automated deployment of foundational resources globally across multiple public clouds. This foundation enables the business to deploy critical workloads, from building a cloud base High Performance Compute (HPC) platform to run huge risk calculations, enabling Citi to leverage GenAI at scale, all the way to enabling payment solutions, this team is at the forefront of innovation.     Role Description:        The role of Public Cloud Network – Security Engineer will be instrumental in ensuring Citi public cloud resources deployed in GCP and AWS are secured using industry standard tools and best practices. You will be responsible for designing, certifying, deploying and managing the security network infrastructure resources within GCP and AWS that secure all traffic flows between resource in the cloud and on-premises. The role requires an engineer with expert technical skills and the ability to collaborate with stakeholders and partners throughout the full resource provisioning life cycle, from inception and design, to deployment, operational management and iterative refinement.  You will have a voice within the team to influence strategic decisions, contribute to the creation of roadmaps and engage with key technology and business stakeholders.   The Network Infrastructure Team is based in multiple locations across the globe and comprises of Architects, Cloud Engineers and Security Engineers.           What you’ll do:       Technical Expertise:   design and build highly resilient and scalable security solutions that support the business requirements as part of the organisations public cloud strategy.      Engineering Excellence:  follow engineering best practices and industry standards using modern tooling that enables CI/CD and favours automation, auditability, automated testing, infrastructure and policy as code.      Collaborative Development:  work with a talented team of cloud engineers across the wider Public Cloud team who are responsible for Network, Project / Account Provisioning, Platform, Data, Pipelines, and Operations. You will also work closely with the business functions who are creating / migrating service and applications to the cloud environment.      Innovate and Automate:  identify and develop automated solutions as part of continual improvement to reduce the time to market of cloud services, enhancing client satisfaction and delivering business value.      Compliance Advocacy:  ensure adherence to relevant standards, policies, and regulations, prioritizing the protection of Citi's reputation, clients, and assets.      What we’ll need from you:       5+ years of relevant experience in an Engineering role  You are a talented and experienced Network Security Engineer with a proven track record of infrastructure design, testing and automated deployment via Infrastructure as Code (IaC).  You will have a expert level understanding of public cloud network security infrastructure services available in GCP and AWS.  Proven ability to implement network segmentation strategies effectively using cloud native services and resources.  Ability to work independently, multi-task, and take ownership of various parts of a project or initiative.  Ability to adapt quickly to changing threat landscapes and business requirements.    Hands-on experience developing and engineering software solutions and services, with a focus on cloud-native applications  Understanding of cloud security best practices and compliance frameworks.  Knowledge of container security and orchestration tools such as Kubernetes.  Extensive experience with CI/CD methodologies and tools.  Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) deployment using Terraform.  Proficiency in Python, Golang, AWS/GCP SDKs      Education:      Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience  Master’s degree preferred                  ------------------------------------------------------                Job Family Group:   Technology              ------------------------------------------------------                Job Family:  Systems & Engineering            ------------------------------------------------------              Time Type:  Full time            ------------------------------------------------------              Primary Location:  Irving Texas United States            ------------------------------------------------------              Primary Location Full Time Salary Range:  $125 760,00 - $188 640,00  In addition to salary, Citi’s offerings may also include, for eligible employees, discretionary and formulaic incentive and retention awards. Citi offers competitive employee benefits, including: medical, dental & vision coverage; 401(k); life, accident, and disability insurance; and wellness programs. title: Senior Solutions Architect, DL Training
description_html: NVIDIA is building the world’s leading AI company, and we are looking for an experienced Senior Solutions Architect to help customers build, scale, and optimize AI training solutions using NVIDIA GPU hardware and software on cloud computing platforms. This role focuses on foundation model pre-training and post-training, with an emphasis on reinforcement learning.   As part of the Solutions Architecture team, you will work with some of the most exciting computing hardware and software technologies, including the latest advances in large-scale AI training. A Solutions Architect serves as a trusted technical advisor between NVIDIA and our customers. You will engage directly with developers, researchers, and infrastructure engineers at some of NVIDIA’s most strategic technology customers, while partnering with our business, product, and engineering teams to inform product strategy. The ideal candidate combines hands-on technical depth with the ability to translate customer needs into scalable solutions using NVIDIA’s accelerated computing platform. Join us in this exciting endeavor!    What you will be doing:    Work with Cloud Service Providers to design, build, and demonstrate scalable AI training solutions using NVIDIA hardware and software.  Lead technical engagements across foundation model pre-training and post-training, helping customers move from architecture and proofs of concept to production adoption.  Develop and optimize end-to-end training workflows spanning data preparation, distributed training, checkpointing, and evaluation, including reinforcement learning pipelines.  Build customer-specific proofs of concept that address critical technical and business needs, demonstrating improvements in training performance, reliability, and efficiency.  Help customers diagnose and resolve bottlenecks across GPU compute, memory, communication, networking, storage, and workload orchestration.  Partner with Sales Account Managers and Developer Relations Managers to identify opportunities and drive adoption of NVIDIA platforms for AI training.  Prepare and deliver technical presentations, workshops, and architecture reviews for audiences ranging from researchers and engineers to technical leaders and executives.  Establish close technical relationships with customers, lead roadmap and architecture discussions, and collaborate with NVIDIA engineering and product teams to resolve issues and inform future capabilities.     What we need to see:    BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, Statistics, Physics, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.  5+ years of relevant professional experience in solutions architecture, software engineering, ML engineering, research engineering, or related technical roles, including 3+ years of hands-on experience with large-scale AI systems or distributed training.  Strong programming and debugging skills in Python, with hands-on experience developing and optimizing deep learning workloads using PyTorch.  Practical experience with foundation model pre-training or post-training, and a strong understanding of the broader model development lifecycle.  Demonstrated ownership of an end-to-end training workflow, including data preparation, training configuration, execution, evaluation, and troubleshooting.  Experience with multi-GPU and multi-node training, including distributed parallelism, mixed precision, memory optimization, and checkpointing.  Established track record of deploying GPU workloads in cloud computing environments such as AWS, GCP, or Azure, with knowledge of containers and workload orchestration.  Ability to lead technical engagements, solve complex problems, and communicate technical ideas and tradeoffs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.     Ways to stand out from the crowd:    Hands-on experience spanning both pre-training and post-training of large language or multimodal models, including supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning.  Experience with reinforcement learning from human feedback or verifiable rewards, including reward design, rollout generation, policy optimization, and training stability.  Experience with NVIDIA NeMo Framework, Megatron Core, Megatron Bridge, PyTorch FSDP, DeepSpeed, or comparable distributed training technologies.  System-level understanding of GPU platforms and experience profiling and optimizing training workloads, with measured improvements in throughput, scaling efficiency, reliability, or cost.    We make extensive use of conferencing tools, but occasional travel is required for on-site customer engagements and industry events. NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you’re creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!                You will also be eligible for equity and  benefits .           Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 9, 2026.   This posting is for an existing vacancy.   NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.   NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Senior Technical Architect – Life Sciences
description_html: To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.      Job Category  Customer Success    Job Details        About Salesforce     Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.    Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.          The Experience   Salesforce Professional Services is seeking a Senior Technical Architect to support our Life Sciences customers within the Customer Success Group (CSG). You will serve as a strategic advisor and Salesforce product and platform expert to pharmaceutical, biotechnology and medical technology organisations, helping them turn business priorities into scalable, secure and maintainable solutions.  You will work with customers and partners to define the solution vision, lead technical architecture and guide implementation across commercial operations, medical affairs, patient services and, where relevant, clinical engagement. You will connect industry needs with platform capabilities while helping customers manage complexity, reduce technical debt and realise long-term value.  The role combines hands-on technical expertise with consulting and leadership. You will engage developers, business stakeholders and executives, align multiple delivery teams and help customers make informed architecture decisions within a regulated environment.   What You'll Actually Be Doing         Serve as a trusted advisor to Life Sciences customers, connecting business objectives with Salesforce architecture, delivery roadmaps and measurable outcomes.    Lead architecture for complex engagements, coordinate the work of solution and technical architects, and align decisions across customers, partners and Salesforce teams.    Translate requirements for healthcare professional (HCP) and healthcare organisation (HCO) engagement, medical affairs, patient support and other relevant Life Sciences processes into practical solution designs.    Design data, integration and security architectures connecting Salesforce with enterprise platforms, master data, content repositories and relevant clinical or safety systems.    Partner with customer quality, privacy, security and regulatory teams to translate applicable requirements into access controls, consent handling, auditability, validation evidence and release governance.    Review architecture, implementation approaches and key deliverables to ensure performance, scalability and maintainability. Guide configuration and development, and contribute hands-on where required.    Shape migration and rollout strategies that address data quality, legacy applications, global standards and local market needs.    Work closely with project and engagement managers to plan delivery, manage dependencies and risks, resolve issues and set clear customer expectations.    Evaluate AI and automation use cases with customers, defining appropriate data access, human oversight and evaluation criteria.    Mentor customers, partners and colleagues; contribute reusable patterns and industry knowledge; and support pre-sales activities where required.        You're Our Person If...         Candidates must already be authorised to work in Italy.    Language: Italian and English fluency.    12+ years of enterprise architecture or technical consulting experience, including 4+ years leading Salesforce implementation projects.    Experience delivering CRM technology solutions (OCE, VEEVA, etc) for pharmaceutical, biotechnology or medical technology organizations, with knowledge of one or more areas such as commercial engagement, market access, medical affairs, patient services or clinical operations.    Strong Salesforce application design skills, supported by experience in data modelling, integration, identity, security and platform scalability.    Hands-on configuration and development experience, including Salesforce customisation and coding in object-oriented languages.    Experience with APIs, enterprise integration patterns, data migration from legacy CRM platforms (Veeva, OCE, etc) and the design of connected enterprise applications.    Understanding of delivery in regulated environments and the ability to work with customer specialists on privacy, consent, data integrity and validation requirements.    Proven ability to lead technical teams, manage architecture decisions and deliver through agile methods across distributed, multidisciplinary teams.    Strong communication, presentation and facilitation skills, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs and influence senior business and technology stakeholders.    Ability to take ownership of complex problems, learn new technologies quickly and travel regionally or occasionally internationally according to customer needs.        Even Better If...         Experience with Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud and its commercial, medical or patient services capabilities.    Experience with HCP/HCO master data, omnichannel engagement, medical content workflows or patient programme integrations.    Experience planning CRM modernisation, legacy platform migration or multi-country deployments for Life Sciences customers.    Compliance knowledge: Knowledge of the standard regulation(GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, GDPR etc).    Core platform skills: as Apex, LWC, APIs, Experience Cloud, Life Science Cloud .    Experience with Agentforce, enterprise data platforms or AI-assisted development tools, including an understanding of their strengths, limitations and governance needs.    Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA) or multiple Salesforce architecture certifications.    Experience leading enterprise transformation and building relationships with C-level executives and senior technology leaders.    A degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent demonstrable professional experience.        What You Bring         Trust: Integrity, transparency and sound judgement when working with customers, colleagues and sensitive information.    Collaboration: A commitment to shared outcomes, knowledge sharing and the development of others.    Leadership: Clear communication, a considered point of view and the confidence to guide decisions while listening to different perspectives.    Industry curiosity: A desire to understand how Life Sciences organisations work and how technology can improve experiences for healthcare professionals and patients.    Adaptability: Comfort with ambiguity and with a fast-changing product and AI landscape.             Unleash Your Potential    When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and     be your best  , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can     do your best  . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. title: Information Security Engineer – Global Security Infrastructure
description_html: Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for  all .    Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.    Micron is expanding and modernizing its global footprint, and physical security technology has to keep pace. Sites today run a mix of systems at different ages and maturity levels. Our goal is a consistent, standards-based security infrastructure everywhere we operate, covering video surveillance and analytics, access control, intrusion detection, visitor management, and perimeter protection. Modern security systems are connected, technology-based platforms, and we want them deployed on predictable schedules and managed as a product, not a collection of one-off projects.     In partnership with the Global Security Operations leadership team, you will own that rollout end to end: planning, sequencing, site readiness, execution, and measurement. You will treat security operators and site leaders as your customers, gather their requirements, and make sure what we deploy works for them.       Responsibilities:     Own the global rollout program.  Build and run the multi-year, multi-site deployment plan for physical security infrastructure upgrades. Sequence sites by risk and readiness, manage scope, schedule, budget, and dependencies, and keep simultaneous projects across regions moving.   Turn standards into repeatable deployments.  Partner with security engineering to translate technology standards and reference designs into deployment playbooks, site readiness checklists, and acceptance criteria so that every site rollout looks the same and gets faster over time.   Bring a product mindset.  Gather requirements from security operators, site security leaders, and regional teams. Run the program with agile practices: prioritize a backlog, define what "done" looks like for each site, iterate on the playbook, and measure whether deployed systems deliver the expected operational outcomes.   Build AI-enabled tooling and automation.  Develop or adopt tools for deployment tracking, configuration standards checks, device health monitoring, and asset and lifecycle management across the global fleet. Use AI tools and agents to speed up program work such as site assessments, status reporting, risk identification, and documentation. Ensure deployed systems, including AI video analytics, produce data that integrates cleanly with the team's security operations data platform.   Coordinate partners and integrators.  Manage external integrators and contractors through statements of work, schedules, and quality checks. Coordinate closely with IT and network teams, Information Security (for device hardening and network segmentation), Facilities and construction teams (especially for new fab builds), and EHS.   Govern and verify.  Establish a governance cadence for the program, track site compliance against security technology standards, and run post-deployment audits to confirm systems are installed, configured, and operating as designed.   Manage risk and change.  Identify and raise program risks early, drive decisions to resolution, and plan for operator training and cutover so new systems are adopted, not just installed.     Report to leadership.  Build clear metrics and dashboards on rollout progress, spend, site compliance, and system health. Present status, risks, and trade-offs to senior leadership in concise, executive-ready form.        Minimum Qualifications:    Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience, plus 5+ years in software product management or software engineering, including ownership of delivering a product or platform to users.  Experience leading cross-functional delivery with multiple teams and external partners, including managing scope, schedule, and budget.  Working knowledge of networked systems, APIs, and integrations, plus scripting or data analysis skills sufficient to build tooling, automate reporting, and hold technical conversations with engineers and integrators.  AI proficiency: hands-on use of generative AI tools (e.g., copilots, LLM-based assistants, or agents) in day-to-day work, with judgment about where AI output needs human review.  Strong written and verbal communication skills, including building executive-level status reports and presentations, and willingness to travel domestically and internationally.        Preferred Qualifications:    Experience rolling out technology across many sites or regions with global teams (for example IoT or edge device fleets, enterprise infrastructure, or manufacturing systems).  Experience with device fleet management, configuration management, or monitoring and observability tools, including applying AI/ML for anomaly detection, predictive maintenance, or automated workflows.  Experience with construction, facilities, or capital projects, including managing integrators or contractors through SOWs and acceptance testing.  Exposure to physical security systems such as video surveillance, access control, or intrusion detection, ideally in semiconductor, manufacturing, or other high-security industrial environments.  Agile certification (e.g., CSM, PSM, SAFe, or PMI-ACP).        As a world leader in the semiconductor industry, Micron is dedicated to your personal wellbeing and professional growth. Micron benefits are designed to help you stay well, provide peace of mind and help you prepare for the future.  We offer a choice of medical, dental and vision plans in all locations enabling team members to select the plans that best meet their family healthcare needs and budget.  Micron also provides benefit programs that help protect your income if you are unable to work due to illness or injury, and paid family leave.  Additionally, Micron benefits include a robust paid time-off program and paid holidays.   For additional information regarding the Benefit programs available, please see the Benefits Guide posted on         micron.com/careers/benefits       .
